breadth.note: No fold-local cross-validation term mining. The empirical primary cell (birth-rate/count decompositions) has a single anchor (Preston-Guillot), far below the >=30 CV floor -- by nature, not by search failure (A.9 is an accounting identity; see cold-start-anchors-log.md). The cause axis is therefore set from the frame probe vocabulary, not learned from gold. Orthogonal recall is carried by the channel-3 Tier-B frame (199 records).

effect_block.note: A.9's outcome is the CBR and the birth COUNT; period TFR and completed cohort fertility are composition-free/irrelevant BY CONSTRUCTION and are not the target outcomes (scope: 'the outcome is not the period TFR'). Backbone therefore emphasizes crude/period birth measures and counts, plus the general fertility terms needed for recall.

cause_block.note: Two tiers. 'backbone' = momentum- and decomposition-specific vocabulary that is clean on the homonym check (frame probe: 'demographic momentum' = 85 even unrestricted). 'gated_extension' = the generic age-structure terms, which are homonym-inflated (bare 'age structure' = 32,363 unrestricted, an ecology/population-genetics term; 3,213 even intersected with fertility) and are admitted ONLY in co-occurrence with a decomposition/CBR term. Bare 'age structure'/'age composition' are NEVER admitted alone.
backbone: components of change in the birth rate

gated_extension.rationale: Frame probe: bare generic terms contribute ~3,000 mostly-off-topic records (ecology, general demography) for a handful of true hits. The co-occurrence gate keeps the decomposition studies and drops the flood.
gated_extension.tested_and_dropped: Run 2026-09-20: the gated axis (generic age-structure terms AND a decomposition/rate co-term AND the effect axis) returned 324 records, but they are dominated by EPIDEMIOLOGICAL rate-standardization/decomposition papers (age-standardized disease-rate methodology), not birth-rate composition -- only ~19 PRIMARY_COMPOSITION hits. The gated extension is therefore DROPPED from the production frame; its few true birth-rate-decomposition hits are expected via the tight axis's explicit 'decomposition of the birth rate' phrases and via the Tier-B snowball. Effective production frame = tight cause axis (~570) UNION Tier-B (199).

boundary_notes.A.11_tempo: OFF_TEMPO_A11. 'tempo effect'/'postponement'/'quantum'/'Bongaarts-Feeney' route to A.11 at the component level (Wall 1); ~136 in-frame overlap measured.
boundary_notes.OFF_OUTCOME_POP: Papers whose outcome is population SIZE/GROWTH/aging, not a birth rate, route off-cell (Wall 3, expected largest class).
boundary_notes.ecology_homonym: Age-structured models of non-human populations route to OFF_OTHER.

orthogonal_channel: population-age-structure-momentum-snowball-tierb.json (199 records) is the Tier-B recall yardstick; it, not a broadened keyword axis, carries recall of quirky-titled canon.
